description: Details of one tool by its slug (from find_tools or list_tools): name, description, page URL in every language, and the in-page agent tools (WebMCP) that a browser agent can call once the page is open. The tools run in the user's web browser: give the user the link. Files are never sent to this server or to the assistant.

language.description: Language of the names, descriptions and pages: en, it, es, fr, de (default en). Use the user's language; English words are understood in every language.

slug.description: The tool slug, e.g. "merge-pdf"; a localized slug ("unire-pdf") or a page URL works too

name: get_tool
title: Get a tool
